title: Lazur vs Wispr Flow on Mac: AI dictation or a voice assistant that sees your screen
metaTitle: Lazur vs Wispr Flow: which one fits your Mac
description: Lazur vs Wispr Flow on Mac: Wispr Flow is AI dictation on every device. Lazur is a voice assistant that sees your screen and dictates. Prices from each site.
intro: Wispr Flow is AI dictation: you talk, it types clean text in any app. Lazur dictates too, but its main job is different: hold ⌥ ⌘ and it sees your screen, answers out loud and points at what you need.
tldr: Wispr Flow is a dictation tool. Lazur is a voice assistant that also dictates.
Pick Wispr Flow if typing by voice is all you need, on more devices.
Pick Lazur if you also want help with what is on your screen: answers, pointing at buttons, step-by-step guidance.
Lazur is free for 3 days, then $18/month.

verdict: If you want the best pure dictation on every device, Wispr Flow is the safer pick. If you are on a Mac and want an assistant that understands your screen as well as dictation, pick Lazur.

faq.question: Is Lazur a good Wispr Flow alternative?
faq.answer: If you want more than dictation, yes. Lazur dictates in any Mac app and also answers questions about your screen, points at buttons and guides you. If you only dictate, Wispr Flow is a fine choice.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur and Wispr Flow together?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as their shortcuts do not clash. Lazur uses hold fn to dictate and hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask.

faq.question: Is Wispr Flow cheaper than Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Wispr Flow Pro is $15/month, or $12/month billed annually, on its pricing page. Lazur Pro is $18/month. Lazur includes the screen-aware assistant, not only dictation.
